Commentary.Commentary: The players are out on the middle. MOHAMMAD HAFEEZ and SAMI ASLAM to open the batting and JAMES ANDERSON will start the bowling proceedings.

Pakistan have made a fitting reply to their one-sided loss in the previous Test match. Today, England will look to get off to a flying start with their pace attack. Pakistan's brittle batting line-up will be sorely tested but are able to come out the stronger. Stay tuned for start of the day's play and our coverage.

Welcome to day 2 of the 3rd Test between England and Pakistan. By the close of the first day, Pakistan were able to restrict the English innings to a score of 297 all out. While each of their bowlers played their part, Sohail Khan was instrumental in removing their key batsmen early on. England had to rely on performances from Gary Ballance and Moeen Ali and the partnerships they managed to stitch together.
...Day 2, Session 1...
Join us tomorrow at 1530 IST for what looks to be a thrilling day of Test cricket that can swing either way. Until then... Cheers and take care!

A beautiful showing by the visitors who have definitely announced that they don't intend for a repeat of the previous Test. They have started off on the right foot but now it is up to their unpredictable batting line up to fulfill their end. England, meanwhile, will look to pile into the batsmen with the new ball and will have an early morning advantage.

Amongst the batsmen, Alastair Cook was the first to show some spark, nearly reaching his fifty, but England didn't have a steady partnership going until the arrival of Gary Ballance and James Vince. Their 69-run stand and Ballance's 66-run stand with Moeen Ali held the innings together. Where other more experienced batsmen failed, Moeen Ali and Gary Ballance showed great discipline and hung in to bring up fifties each.

That ends the English innings, one undeniably dominated by Pakistan. England fought all the way to put up a total of 297 but they didn't have any answer to Sohail Khan, who ripped into their top order and finished with a 5-wicket haul. The rest of the bowlers were not as potent, however, each played their part and collected scalps of their own.
End of a fantastic day of Test cricket! Sohail Khan is all smiles as he leaves the field. Wait, he does a few push-ups before joining his teammates who are loosening up near the fence.

OUT! The decision stays as it is and Sohail Khan gets his maiden 5-wicket haul in Tests! He serves a beautiful inswinging delivery, landing around middle and catching Anderson on the pads who fails to keep it out. They appeal and the finger goes up. Sohail Khan is kissing the turf in jubilation as Anderson calls for the DRS. The replays show it to be clipping leg. ENGLAND BOWLED OUT FOR 297 and it will be STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Anderson is adjudged lbw and he has reviewed it just because he has the luxury of reviewing it. Looks dead plumb to the naked eye.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Ho! Ho! Ho! Back of a length ball on off, Finn swivels on the back foot and pulls it firmly across the line. He bisects the two square fielders in the deep on the leg side for a boundary.
A typical fast bowler's reply, short and around off, an effort ball, Finn tries his best to pull but fails to connect.
FOUR! What a shot! Finn continues to surprise... He receives a length ball around off and hits it on the up and down the ground past the left side of the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Fullish and outside off, curving away off the seam, Finn pushes at it and misses.
Amir comes from round the wicket and angles in a length ball outside off, Finn gets forward to drive it through covers but ends up edging it down to third man. A single taken.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Finn ducks by leaving his bat hanging like a periscope.
Length ball on middle and off, Finn gets squared up a bit and defends it back to the bowler.

Good length ball angling into the batsman, Anderson once again comes down the track and swings his bat. The outside edge flies down to third man but doesn't carry to the fielder in the deep. They cross for a run.
Here is the response from Amir. Lands a full length ball on off, nipping away, Anderson tries to play it with a straight bat but fails to do so.

FOUR! Anderson is not going to die wondering! Advances down the track to a shortish ball and chances his arms. He swings his bat blindly and the outside edge flies over the slip cordon for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, shaping away, Finn restrains himself from pushing at it.
FOUR! Nicely played and it's welcomed with a big cheer from the crowd. A fuller length ball on off, Finn brings his bottom hand into play and whips it past wide mid on for a boundary.
Beaten! Fuller in length outside off, moving away, Finn is on the front foot as he looks to drive but gets beaten by the away movement.

Appeal for an lbw! Khan lands a full ball around leg and gets it to move away a shade towards off, Finn fails to keep it out and is struck on the pads. They appeal but it seems to be quite high and going down the leg side as well.
Some late away movement on this occasion, outside off, Finn covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Full in length and outside off, Finn pushes it on the up but finds the short extra cover fielder.
Lands it on a length outside off, Anderson pushes at it and misses. End of a top class over by Amir!
Length ball around off, zipping off the surface, another play and a miss for Anderson.

Beauty of a delivery. The new ball is talking. Amir lands it closer to the off stump and takes it away off the seam. Too good a ball for the number 11 and Anderson ends up getting beaten comprehensively.
Outside off, shaping away, Anderson plays inside the line and misses.
Length ball outside off, Anderson leaves it untouched.
JAMES ANDERSON is the last batsman for England.

OUT! Moeen departs! Amir strikes again. He hurls across a length ball wide outside off, Ali goes hard at it and tries to hit it through the off side. However, he gets a faint outside edge straight into the gloves of Sarfraz. Catching has been good from Pakistan today and it brings an end to a valuable knock from Moeen.
Darts in a very full ball on off, Finn digs it out back to the bowler and survives.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump. Much better from Steven!
Rash shot attempted! Full in length and wide outside off, shaping away, Finn swishes and misses.

NOT OUT! CLOSE CALL! Length ball on middle and off, Finn looks to play it but misses and is hit on the pads. This time the umpire shakes his head and the Pakistani side decide to send the decision upstairs. It looks like a close call but with no obvious edge, things seem to be going Pakistan's way. The ball tracking, however, shows that the ball is just clipping the top of the off stump and the decision is umpire's call. With that, Finn gets a second lease on life!
The umpire has given FINN not out. Review for LBW called for by Pakistan.
Good length delivery, slightly wider outside off, Finn thinks to play it but leaves it at the last moment.
Length ball outside off and angled away, Finn shoulders his arms.
No ball. Fourth official no ball for Sohail. Length ball outside off, Finn leaves it.
SOHAIL KHAN to bowl from the other end.
Angling away from the right-hander, Finn pushes inside the line and edges it past gully for a single.
Amir keeps probing with a length ball outside off, this time Finn feels for it and gets beaten.
Length ball angling away from the batsman, Finn allows it through to the keeper.
Good delivery, it's full and around off, Finn defends it by getting on the front foot.
STEVEN FINN is the new man in.

OUT! THE SECOND NEW BALL STRIKES STRAIGHTAWAY! Length ball outside off, Broad swivels in place and slashes it hard through the slips. Azhar Ali is ready and reaches up to take a sharp catch over his head with both hands at third slip. That was some impressive fielding as the ball was flying in at a speedy clip!
Pakistan have now taken the second new ball. Reviews are reset now.
Full ball on the pads, flicked down the leg side for a single.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back on but is bowling with the old ball.
SECOND NEW BALL IS DUE NOW.
Slow loopy full ball on middle, Broad gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter on off, punched off the back foot to mid off.
Flighted and around middle, Broad goes back and turns it with the spin to fine leg. A couple of runs taken.
Another watchful defensive shot played by Broad.
Broad has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
And again. Shortish and outside off, hit in the deep on the off side and Sami Aslam does the fielding neatly in spite of all the jeering from the crowd. A single taken.
Umbrellas back out in the stands...
Short and outside off, played through point and a huge roar from the crowd as the ball approaches Sami Aslam. The young man makes no mistake this time and they have to satisfy with only a single.
FOUR! Shot! Full and angling into the batsman, Moeen brings down a straight bat and executes a well timed on drive for a boundary. No stopping this!

FOUR! Debutant Sami Aslam misfields in the deep! Short and wide outside off, Moeen camps back and slaps it to deep point. Aslam gets to the ball to stop it but makes a complete mess. He concedes a boundary and has his head hanging down. Not a good place to commit that misfield, that is right in front of the English crowd. They will be after you every time the ball will come at you.
Once again Rahat angles in full length ball, landing around off, Moeen defends it to the off side.
Angles in a length ball on off, Moeen gets behind the line and keeps it out off the inside half of the bat.
Quicker and flatter once again, around off, Broad goes on the back foot and punches it to the off side.
Flat and on off, it's defended off the back foot by Stuart.

FOUR! Looked like a mishit but luckily for Broad it's in the gap. Flighted full ball on middle, Broad tries to heave it over mid-wicket but ends up dragging it off the toe end of the bat. It goes wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder and crosses the fence.
Broad has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter and quicker on middle, defended with firm hands to short leg.
Full floated ball on off, Broad gets forward and defends.

PEACH! Beautifully bowled by Rahat, right on the money with his line this time, lands it around off and gets it to nip away ever so slightly to beat the outside edge of Moeen's bat. Rahat has got this knack of bowling beauties!
PLAY AND A MISS! Wayward delivery by Rahat, on a shortish length and way wide outside off, Moeen chases it but fails to put bat on ball.
Around off on a length, Moeen punches it down to mid on.
Angles in a good length ball on off, Ali defends it off his back foot.
Lands it on a fuller length outside off and gets it to straighten a bit, Moeen shoulders arms.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Full on middle, Broad edges it onto his pads.
Chipped! Full around off, Moeen looks to come down and drive it but miscues it over mid on for a single.
Down the leg side, Broad flicks it to backward square leg for a single.
Moeen comes down the track and drives it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full around off, defended off the front foot to the leg side.
Tossed up around off, defended to the covers.
FOUR! Shot! Slightly over pitched and outside off, Moeen wastes no time in driving it through the covers for a boundary.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Short ball outside off, punched to point for a single.
Good length ball and swinging in, it strikes Moeen on the thigh-pad.
6th Test fifty for Moeen Ali!

FOUR! Short ball around off, Moeen goes on the back foot, stands tall and nails his pull shot through mid-wicket for a boundary. A valuable knock by Moeen and it has kept England on track for a decent first innings total.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tickles a full ball on middle to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Spinning down, Broad goes back and turns it to fine leg for a single.
Too full in length on off, Broad lunges and defends it back.
Tossed up ball outside off, Moeen gets forward and pushes it wide of point for a single.

NOT OUT! Flighted ball landing around leg and straightening a touch, Moeen goes down on one knee for the sweep shot but fails to connect properly. It pops out of his pads and the short leg fielder collects the ball. They appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Moeen wants it reviewed and takes the DRS. The third umpire Kumar Dharmasena has a look at everything possible and finds no evidence of inside edge or gloves on it. Also the Hawk Eye shows it to be clipping leg. But since umpire Bruce Oxenford only wanted it to be checked for bat and pad, hence the decision is overruled. Mr. Oxenford was pretty sure that it's not lbw. Fair decision made in the end.
Moeen Ali has been given caught out at short leg by the umpire and he has referred it upstairs.
On a good length and outside off, Broad shoulders arms. End of a very good over!
Rahat bangs in a short ball around middle, well-directed, Broad fails to move away from the line of fire and takes a blow on his right shoulder.
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, holding its line, Broad has a nervous push inside the line and misses.
STUART BROAD is the new batsman.
Drinks break...

OUT! EDGED! That's a beautiful delivery by Ali! Back of a length delivery just enough outside the off stump, to force the batsman to play it. Woakes looks to defend it off the back foot but the ball angles away just the tiniest bit. It takes the slightest of edges and goes to the keeper for a comfortable catch. That's yet another in-form batsman for England who goes down.
Full on middle, played to mid-wicket for a single.
Wide outside off, Moeen looks to cut it but misses.
Wide called for height! That was a very short delivery, leading the umpire to spread his hands. Moeen leaves it comfortably.
RAHAT ALI is back into the attack for another spell.
Full ball around off, Woakes defends it off the front foot.
Wide outside off, Woakes leaves it.

The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Over the wicket on on the pads, worked through the on side for a single.

Length ball outside off, left alone.
FOUR! SLASHED! Length ball wide outside off, Woakes gives that ball what it deserves. He cuts it through cover-point for a lightning boundary.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Woakes drives it through the covers and the ball races across the fence.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.

Outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Full delivery around off, Woakes defends it to short extra cover.
Outside off, Woakes comes forward and drives it to the covers again.
Full ball outside off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
Tossed up around off, driven to the covers.
Loopy ball outside off, driven down the ground to mid on for a single.
Drops it on a length and outside off, Woakes stands back and taps it down to point.
Down the leg side, on a length, Woakes tries to flick but misses.
On a length and outside off, it's left alone by Chris.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Woakes tries to flick it on the leg side but gets a little leading edge back to the bowler. Doesn't carry.
Full in length and sliding down the leg side, Moeen eases it to backward square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for a couple of runs.
Woakes has played that off the front foot and into the ground. End of a successful over.
Tossed up ball on off, pushed with the spin to covers.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Shortish on off, cut straight to point.

OUT! CAUGHT OFF BALANCED! Flighted ball landing on off, from round the wicket and spinning down, Ballance gets forward and looks to defend it but the ball curls in and takes an inside edge. It goes down the leg side and the keeper bends low to take a sharp catch (ripper by his standards). This is the fourth time that Ballance has been caught in his 70s in Tests!! Thus ends a 66-run partnership that did much to steady the English innings.
FOUR! Fine shot! Ballance gets to the pitch of the ball and whips it with the spin through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fullish on middle, Moeen tries to work it on the leg side but ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
Much better this time by Moeen. Offers the full face of the bat to a full ball on off and pushes it down to mid off.
Short and wide outside off, Moeen loses patience and throws his bat at it. Fails to get any connection and is lucky not to have edged it.

Nearly chops it on! FOUR! Khan keeps it on a length around off, angling away, Moeen decides not to offer any shot but is late in lifting his bat. It takes the inside edge, beats the stumps by a whisker and races away to the fine leg fence.
Identical to the last delivery, a little bit of swing on this occasion too, Moeen leaves it again. Sarfraz with a good take behind the stumps.
Full in length and angling away from the batsman, there to be driven but Moeen allows it through to the keeper.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched down to long on for one.
Tossed up ball curling into the left-hander, Moeen works it on the leg side but finds the fielder.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it with the spin to the leg side.
Tossed up ball on off, Ballance is forward in defense.
Shah comes from round the wicket and bowls a full ball around off, Ballance defends it off his back foot.
Length ball on middle and off, worked to square leg for a single.

Good length on middle, Gary gets back and tries to block it. It looks like he is trying to turn and alter his shot and the ball comes off the face of his bat. It goes to the bowler who dives for it but it doesn't carry.
Short ball outside off, Ballance wisely leaves it.
Short ball, played to point for a single.
FOUR! CONTROLLED! Shorter delivery outside off, Moeen has waited long for this and he makes the most of it. He is in complete control as he cuts it strongly through the covers for a boundary.
Wide outside off, Ali reaches across and gets a glancing cut to the covers.
SOHAIL KHAN is back into the attack.
50-run stand between Gary Ballance and Moeen Ali!
On the pads, Moeen flicks it through the leg side for a single.
Flighted around off, whipped to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle, worked to square leg. There is a bit of hesitation and the batsmen decide to stick to a single.
Full on the stumps, Moeen comes down the ground and drives it down the ground to the fielder at mid off for a single.
On middle and off, Moeen has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Straighter ball on middle and off, played back to the bowler.
Length ball on middle and leg, nudged neatly away through backward square leg for a couple.
Ballance defends it from within the crease.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! IN THE ZONE! Ballance has no problem tucking it down the ground for a boundary at long off.
GB has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the middle, flicked to the leg side.On the middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball on middle and off, blocked back down the line of the delivery.
Looped on the legs, worked to the leg side.
Full on middle and off, defended off the front foot back to the bowler.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Tossed up outside off, punched off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Short ball outside off, Ballance looks to defend it but misses.
Outside off and second bouncer, Ballance does well to avoid it.
Bouncer! Ballance gets down on one knee to let it go outside the off stump.
Length ball on the stumps, worked to square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, defended to point.
Short ball outside off, left alone.
Not much turn and Gary works it down the leg side.
On middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
Short ball on middle and off, worked down the leg side.
FOUR! Nicely balanced! Full outside off, Gary takes a massive stride forward, lets the ball come to him and drives it carefully through the covers for a boundary.
Full on middle and off, defended off the front foot back to the bowler.
Ballance has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full around off, driven through mid on.
A better delivery outside off, Moeen lets it through.
Down the leg side again, Moeen looks to flick it but misses.
Wide down the leg side, left alone by Moeen.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, GB tries to flick it but gets a leading edge and the ball travels through the covers. Two fielders scramble after it but not before the batsmen run a triple.
Back of a length delivery around off, Ali stays back and guides it to third man for a single.
Drifting across off, played to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up on middle, clipped to mid-wicket.
Full on the stumps, Ballance has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on middle and off, defended off the front foot to the bowler.
Played to mid-wicket region by Moeen for a single.

False alarm! Good length delivery on middle, the ball squeezes between the bat and hits the batsman high on the thigh pad and goes to the keeper. There is a prolonged appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Replay shows that the sound was bat hitting pad and not of an edge.
Very short delivery on middle and off, Ballance leans back to avoid it.
Full on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Short delivery down the leg side, Gary shoulders arms to let it through.
Fuller ball around off, defended off the front foot with a straight bat.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Fullish ball on middle, played off the front foot back to the bowler.
7th Test fifty for Ballance, 1st against Pakistan!

Full on middle and off, worked to mid-wicket by Gary. The crowd roars in approval as he finally runs a single and gets his half-century. Very well deserved and has served his country right in a tight spot.
Landed around off, defended back to the bowler.
Full on middle, blocked off the front foot.
Full around off, Balace gets forward and defends it.
Loosener wide down the leg side, Ballance tries to sweep it but misses.
YASIR SHAH to bowl from the other end.

Fuller ball outside off, left alone.

Fuller around off, defended from within the crease.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Moeen Ali leans across and cuts it right from the middle of the bat to send it flying through the covers for a boundary.
Short ball around off, Moeen stands tall and blocks it with the full face of the bat.

The players are out on the field. England's GARY BALLANCE and MOEEN ALI are trying their best to hold on but it remains to be seen if they can withstand Pakistan's bowlers. RAHAT ALI to resume the bowling.
...Day 1, Session 3...

Gary Ballance has batted watchfully for his 49 and England will be hoping that he bats long with the lower order batsmen and takes the hosts to a good total. They still have a few handy batsmen to come. For Pakistan, they want their other bowlers apart from Sohail Khan to stand tall and deliver. So far, they have been off-target. Do join us in a short while for the last session.

Another good session for Pakistan as they managed to pick a couple of wickets and didn't let England score freely as well. However, in the early part of the afternoon session, the pair of Vince and Ballance batted well to raise a 69-run stand. Sohail Khan once again was the best bowler on show, picking both the wickets to fall in this session.
And the answer is no. Full flighted ball on middle, Ballance hits it firmly down to mid on. TEA ON DAY 1!
Ballance on 49. Last ball of the session coming up. Can he get to his fifty before tea?
Flighted ball on middle, Moeen flicks it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Too full in length and around off, Ali is on the front foot in defense.
Presses forward and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Gets forward and pushes it off the inside edge towards short leg. Doesn't carry to Azhar Ali under the helmet.
Tossed up ball on middle, Moeen goes back and defends it to short leg.

Third slip moves out.
Back of a length ball outside off, Moeen shoulders his arms to let it through.

Length ball outside off, defended off the front foot to the covers.
Extra cover moves to third slip.

Full on middle and off, defended off the front foot with a straight bat.

Length delivery on middle and off, worked to the leg side to put Ballance back on strike.
Back of a length ball outside off, Moeen stands tall and blocks it with a straight bat.

On the stumps, played to mid-wicket.

Too full in length and around leg, Moeen flicks it through mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a couple of runs.
Length ball around middle and off, Moeen gets behind the line and blocks it safely.
Angles across a full length ball outside off, Moeen watches the line closely and shoulders arms.
MOEEN ALI is the new batsman.

OUT! No. 4 for Sohail! A poor ball to start with, short and around off, asking to be hit. Jonny tries to cut it over point but gets a fat outside edge due to some extra bounce. The ball takes a short hop to the keeper and it's all over for the batsman. Bairstow was trying to play a positive shot but suffered a rare failure. He looks bemused as he walks off. England have lost their second most consistent batsman after Joe Root in the recent past.
Fuller in length and on off, Bairstow presents a solid front foot defence.
Landed on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket.
Full delivery outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Fuller delivery, Bairstow pushes it to the covers.
FOUR! CLIPPED OVER! Full ball around off, Bairstow dances down the track and straight drives it over the bowler's head and to the boundary line.
Floated outisde off, defended to the off side.
Full around off, defended with a straight bat to the off side.
Drinks break.
Short and wide outside off, Bairstow gets some power behind that and cuts it through point. A dedicated chase sees the fielder run it down but not before the batsmen run a triple.
Length ball outside off, Ballance flicks it off his pads for a single.
Bouncer! Ballance ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot to the off side for a single.
Short ball outside off, well left by Bairstow.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Ballance tries to work it on the leg side but misses. He is hit high on the pads. Replay shows that it was a big overstep and should have been a no ball.
A low full toss on off, Ballance pushes it off his front foot to covers.
Flatter ball outside off, Bairstow goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Loopy full toss on middle, Ballance drives it to the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, Bairstow drives and this time finds the gap at covers. A single taken.
Nice loopy ball again, it's full and around off, Bairstow defends it with an angled bat to point.
Loopy full ball on off, it's driven off the front foot to short extra cover.
Full length ball angling into the batsman, Bairstow clips it through square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
JONNY BAIRSTOW is the new batsman.

OUT! IT CARRIES! Third wicket for Sohail Khan! Back of a length delivery outside off, Vince stays on the back foot and looks to push it from behind the line but the ball swings away and takes an outside edge with it. It travels to second slip where Younis Khan leans forward to take it. He gets both hands under it and the fielders celebrate but the umpires are not sure. They have a chat before sending the decision upstairs. The third umpire declares it a fair delivery and has to watch the catch from a number of angles. The ball appears to drop right ahead of the fielder but replays from other angles show that Younis Khan's fingers were creeping under it to cushion its fall. Good use of the camera angle and we have a conclusive result - Vince is out! End of a 69-run partnership but ENGLAND ARE IN SOME REAL TROUBLE HERE.
Vince has been caught at second slip by Younis Khan. Has that carried? The umpires are checking upstairs...
Length ball wide outside off, the ball swings well away and it's an easy leave for James.
BOUNCER! Vince ducks well in time to avoid it.
Fuller ball on middle, Vince flicks it with firm hands through to deep mid-wicket. The batsmen push for three but get a brace.
Short ball a tad outside off, Vince is pushed back and lets it through.
Full at the off stump, GB defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. End of a tidy maiden.
Tossed up on middle and off, blocked with a straight bat.
Flatter ball outside off, defended back to the bowler.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads.
Outside off, defended off the front foot keeping his hands low on the handle.
Tossed up on middle and off, defended off the front foot to point.
Fullish ball outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Fuller ball around off, Vince closes his bat and taps it to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball on the pads, Gary looks to flick it but is hit on the pads. The batsmen run a single. Leg byes signalled by the umpire.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, defended to the leg side.
Short ball on middle and off, Ballance rears up and nudges it to square leg for a single. The umpire signals a No Ball as the bowler oversteps.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ballance shoulders his arms.
Fuller ball down the leg side, Ballance looks to flick it but misses.
Full ball on middle and off, driven back to the bowler.
Loopy ball outside off, Vince has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller ball outside off, driven to the covers.
Outside off, Vince lets it through again.
Flighted outside off, left alone.
Looped in on middle, defended to mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball around off, angling away, Ballance stays back, pokes at it and gets beaten. Good over by Khan!
Too full in length and on off, GB gets half forward and pushes it down to mid on.
Full and wide outside off, easily left by Ballance.
On a length and moving away from the batsman, Ballance has a needless push inside the line and misses.

Goes very full with his length and lands it around off, Ballance presses forward and jams it out to the off side. It's a conscious effort by Gary to transfer his weight forward whenever it's full in length. Has struggled in past due to his rigid footwork.
Good length ball around middle, some extra bounce, Ballance fails to defend it off his front foot and is hit high on the pads.
Change of ends for SOHAIL KHAN.
Flatter on off, punched off the back foot to mid on.

FOUR! Beautiful shot! A tossed up ball around off, too full in length, Vince gets forward with a good stretch and drives it crisply through covers. There is a sweeper on the off side but he fails to cut it off as the ball speeds past him to the fence.
Flighted and full around off, good line and length on this occasion, James gets forward and defends it to the off side.
Short again, around off, it's punched down to mid on.
Tossed up ball outside off, Vince allowed it through.
FOUR! A gentle loosener, short and around off, Vince goes deep inside the crease and pulls it past short leg for a boundary.
YASIR SHAH is back on.

FOUR! Not trying to hit it too hard, just timing it well. Full in length around off, Ballance gets forward nicely and pushes it with exquisite timing past his partner at the other end. It just races through and crosses the fence in no time. England scoring at a good rate after lunch!
On a length outside off, shaping away, Gary shoulders arms.
Full in length and pitched in the right area, Ballance lets the ball go outside his off stump.
50-run stand between Gary Ballance and James Vince.

FOUR! Easy pickings! Wrong line by Rahat this time, it's on a length and down the leg side, Ballance picks it off his pads and neatly deflects it down to the fine leg fence. A crucial stand this for England!
Fullish this time, around off, Gary gets across a bit and pushes it off the inside half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Fuller in length on off, Ballance gets on the front foot in defense.
FOUR! Well played! Full in length and outside off, once again Vince plays it late and dabs it right through the gap between slips and gully for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A strong breeze is blowing across the stadium...
Full and just outside off, Vince gets behind the line and defends it with an angled bat to the off side.
Back of a length ball on off, shaping away a touch, Vince plays it nice and late and taps it down to backward point.
FOUR! Full in length and angling into the batsman, a little too straight this time and Vince picks it early. He gets forward and flicks it nicely through the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary.
A length ball angling down the leg side, Vince glances it through square leg and rushes back for the second run. Good running between the wickets.
Lands it on a fuller length outside off, Ballance once again gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
Fullish and on off, Ballance is well forward in defense.
FOUR! Up and over! Rahat digs in a short ball outside off, Ballance leans back and upper cuts it over the slop cordon for a boundary. He is trying to be positive with his stroke play.
It has started to drizzle and a few umbrellas are coming up in the stands...
Full in length and wide outside off, swinging away, Ballance leaves it unplayed.
Fuller in length and around middle, Vince looks to play it straight but it takes the inside half of the bat before squirting through backward square leg. A single taken.
Good length ball angling away from the batsman, Vince watches the line closely and decides to offer on shot.
Khan goes full with his length this time and lands it closer to the off stump line. Not close enough though to make the batsman play.
FOUR! Fine shot! Sohail is on the shorter side with his length, outside off, Ballance loves it there. He just camps back and carves it through point for a boundary.
Sohail lets out a grunt and bowls a good  length delivery. But it's pitched way wide outside off and Ballance leaves it with ease.
Angles across a length ball outside off, Ballance leaves it alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Good length delivery just outside off, Vince is caught in two minds and takes a late call to leave it. But his bat is still hanging outside off and the ball takes the outside edge. Luckily it doesn't carry to the fielders at slip cordon and goes through it. They cross for a run.
Oversteps first ball and serves a length ball outside off, Vince shoulders arms. No ball called!
SOHAIL KHAN to bowl from the other end.

HUGE SHOUT FOR AN LBW! Rahat spears in a full length ball on middle and leg, angling down, Ballance is stuck inside the crease and leans across to flick on the leg side. But he misses the ball completely and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Misbah has a little chat with his keeper and bowler and the former is quite sure that it's missing leg. No review taken and it's a good decision. The replays confirm that it's just clipping leg and would have been the umpire's call eventually.
Rahat drags his length ball and lands it just outside off, Ballance goes on the back foot, jumps and defends it to the off side.
Full again and angling into the batsman, Ballance draws forward and brings his bat and pad together in defense.
Full in length and outside off, Ballance gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Straighter in line this time, Vince eases it through square leg for a single.
Serves it on a good length and around off, Vince defends it off his back foot.

Welcome back for the afternoon session. The players are making their way out in the centre. Pakistan are into England's fragile middle order now and would like to nip in a few more wickets while England will be looking for a partnership to stabilize things around. Rahat Ali to begin proceedings...
...DAY 1, SESSION 2...

The ball is moving around and there is ample support for the bowlers. Right now, Gary Ballance and James Vince (arguably the weaker link) are batting and England will hope that this pair bats long and bails them out. Pakistan would look to get tighter with their bowling lines and avoid giving easy runs. Another riveting session awaits us, do join us in a short while.

Fantastic morning session for Pakistan! They put England to bat and the Pakistani seamers, especially Sohail Khan, made it count. He used the conditions to his advantage and managed to pick two top order wickets which included Joe Root. Alastair Cook looked in good touch but he too fell after getting a start which put Pakistan on top. Mohammad Amir and Rahat Ali were on the expensive side and as a result, England also have 100 runs on the board.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot back to the bowler. End of a good over. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Flighted on middle, defended off the back foot by the southpaw.
Loopy delivery on leg, played to mid-wicket.
Full outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Full around off, driven down the ground.
Outside off and straight, Vince leaves it alone.
Length delivery, Ballance has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Shorter ball, nipping back in and hitting the batsman on the thigh pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On the pads, worked to mid-wicket for a couple.
Yorker outside off, well left by Ballance.
AMIR back on.
Landed on middle and off, Gary steps forward again and defends it to the leg side for a single.
Once more, Gary smothers the spin with a big step forward.
On middle, Ballance takes a big stride forward and defends it.
Loopy ball on middle and off, defended off the front foot back to the bowler.
Served on off, defended back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
YASIR SHAH to roll his arm.
The southpaw lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Shorter ball on middle and off, worked to mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! DOWN THE GROUND! Full delivery on the stumps, Ballance moves across and watchfully pushes it past the bowler and makes it to the long on boundary.

Fuller ball on middle, Gary presents a front foot defence and appears to be struck on the pads. The umpire says not out in response to the appeal and the replays show that there was definitely an inside edge.
Good length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
Length ball outside off, defended to mid on for a single.
Fullish outside off, Ballance taps it down from within the crease.
FOUR! Full ball outside off, Gary puts some weight behind it and drives it through mid off for a boundary.
Fuller ball outside off, Ballance lets it through.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.

FOUR! A LUCKY EDGE! Full ball around off, the southpaw looks to push it with the full face of the bat but gets a leading edge. There are many gaps in the fielding arrangements and the ball goes through point for a boundary.
Shorter ball outside off, Vince shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length ball, punched through mid on for a single.
Fuller ball around off, it takes the outside edge and goes towards the slip region but does not carry.
Length ball outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Length ball outside off, angling away, left alone.
Full ball outside off, driven to the fielder at the covers.
Amir bowls it closer to the off stump line, holding its line, Vince comes up with a brave leave. That was very close to the off stump.
Fullish and outside off, angling away, Vince this time gets on the front foot to cover the line and leaves it untouched.
Beaten on this occasion. This one is pitched on a length and is angling away from batsman, Vince stays back, pushes inside the line and gets beaten. Should have been forward there and left it alone.

FOUR! Identical to the last delivery, this time Vince commits himself on the front foot and drives it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary. Pakistan won't mind this shot much as there are chances of outside edge.
It's bowled on the driving length around off, Vince shows good composure and patience as he allows it  through to the keeper.
Amir angles across a length ball outside off, getting it to shape away, Vince shoulders arms.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Edged but safe! Ali gets a length ball to move away a shade from the batsman, Ballance has a nervous push inside the line and edges it. Luckily for him, it doesn't carry to the gully fielder.
Fuller in length and wide outside off, zipping off the surface with away movement, Ballance once again leaves it alone watchfully.
Bowls it on a length and outside off, shaping away, Ballance gets forward and leaves it alone.
GARY BALLANCE is the new batsman.

OUT! COOK HAS TO GO! Ali notices how Cook is stepping forward and pitches a length ball around off. Once more, the southpaw steps forward to play it. He has a straight bat out to block it but the ball swings in a bit and smacks into his pads. The fielding side appeals and the umpire gives it. Cook decides to review it, perhaps hoping that the impact was outside off. The third umpire calls it a legal delivery and all the other indicators show that the umpire's call was the right one and Cook has to make his way back. Following Root's dismissal, that is a huge loss for England!
An LBW appeal for Cook has been given out. The English have decided to go in for a review.
Good length delivery outside off, Cook steps forward but lets it through.
Length ball outside off, left alone. A good show of discipline from Vince.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Fuller delivery outside off, the ball angles away sharply and Vince leaves it comfortably.
Cook works it down the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, pushed off the front foot presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! SQUEEZED! Fuller ball outside off, the southpaw steps forward and angles his bat. He crafts an edge and finds the gap to send the ball for a boundary at long leg.
MOHAMMAD AMIR changes his ends.
The batsman goes after a wide one but misses.
FOUR! Fuller ball on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a boundary. Vince seems to be fond of this shot.
Fullish outside off, pushed to the covers for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, left alone.
Cook lets the ball go outside his off stump.

FOUR! FLICKED THROUGH! Fuller delivery on the pads, Cook bends forward and makes good use of his wrists as he works it through mid-wicket. He makes sure the ball isn't flighted and that it goes all the way to the fence.
Short, pacy delivery around off, Vince is quick to rear up and defend it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery, the ball angles away wide outside off and is left alone.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot to point.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Short ball outside off, Vince plays it off the back foot with an angled bat to the off side.
Length ball on middle and off, flicked to the leg side for a single.
No ball. Fuller ball outside off, defended to the off side for a single. In addition, the umpire signals a no ball.
On off, the batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, Cook defends it watchfully off the back foot.
Length ball wide outside off, left alone.
FOUR! PUSHED! Full outside off, Cook steps forward and drives it carefully through mid off and the ball is placed well enough to make it across the ropes.
APPEAL FOR LBW! Length ball on middle, the ball angles past Cook's defence and thuds high into his pads. There is an enthusiastic appeal but the umpire isn't impressed as the ball was going too high.
Good length delivery outside off, Cook nudges it to square leg. He isn't too happy as he wanted to play it to mid on instead but was off balance.
Full on middle, blocked off the front foot back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Excellent delivery from Sohail! Angling away just enough outside off, Vince is tempted to play it and nearly gives away an edge.
Length ball outside off, defended off the front foot for a single.
Shorter ball outside off, Vince looks to defend it but gets an inside edge on that which goes fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Back of a length ball on the pads, flicked to square leg.
Length ball on middle and off, worked to backward square leg for a single.
...Drinks break...
Good length outside the off stump, Vince shoulders his arms to let it through.
Length ball down the leg side, Vince looks to flick it but misses.
Good length delivery on the stumps, flicked to square leg.
Short delivery outside off and angling away, left alone.
Full ball around off, driven back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, swinging away, Vince shoulders his arms.
Lands it on a full length outside off, Vince gets forward, opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man. They take three runs.
JAMES VINCE is the next batsman in.

OUT! MASSIVE BREAKTHROUGH FOR PAKISTAN! The English run-machine falls cheaply! Khan serves a back of a length ball just outside off and gets it to straighten a touch, Root rocks back to punch it through covers but ends up edging it straight to Hafeez at first slip. He makes no mistake (for a change) and Pakistan are on top. Sohail Khan has bowled beautifully this morning and has been rewarded with a couple of wickets, so far.
Khan goes full with his length and lands it around off, Root presses forward and drives it through mid off for a couple.
Brings a shortish ball back into the batsman from outside off, Root goes back and blocks it to the off side.
Lands it on a length and in the channel outside off, Root shoulders arms.
Back of a length ball on off, Root stays back in defense.
Around off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
Length ball outside off, Cook lets it through.
A lucky break! Length ball around off, Cook looks to push it off the front foot and edges it to the slips but it does not carry.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! COOK'S SPOT! Length ball outside off, and the captain gets forward. This is his favoured area and he is all happy to put the ball away with a square drive for a boundary.
Short ball around off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! CRACKED DOWN THE GROUND! Full on off, Cook cracks that drive through mid off and the ball is sent down the length of the ground to the fence.
Fuller ball on middle, Root works it down the leg side for a single.
JOE ROOT is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND CAUGHT! Fuller delivery outside off, similar to the previous ball and this time Hales looks to defend it off the back foot and gets a nick. It's an easy catch for the keeper who is overjoyed to pouch it. First one down for England.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Hales looks to defend it but the ball nearly takes an outside edge.
Fuller ball around off, Hales has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! LUCKY BREAK FOR COOK! Good length delivery outside off, Cook is unsure whether to take it or leave it but decides to play it. The ball takes an inside edge and misses the stumps and goes to the fine leg boundary. End of an excellent over!
Another close call! Cook goes for a back foot defence but the ball swings away and nearly takes an edge on its way to the keeper.
Tight one! Length ball a tad outside off, Cook is cramped and forced to leave it.
Fuller ball around off, Cook shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! CUT AWAY! Back of a length ball outside off, Cook waits for it and cuts it with the full meat of the bat. The ball is sent racing for a boundary through cover-point.
Short ball around off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
RAHAT ALI comes into the attack.
Length ball outside off, Hales chooses to let it through.
Full ball around off, driven hard through the covers.
FOUR! EDGED! A bit short and a bit wide, Hales looks to push that one and gets an outside edge. Luckily for him, it passes through the slips and makes it all the way to the third man boundary.
BEATEN! Great ball! Good line and length, the ball passes the outside edge of Hales' bat to the keeper. A bit fuller and Hales would have been in real trouble.
The ball hits Hales low on the pads. Going down.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle and off, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman gets across the stumps and flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Outside off, Hales taps it off the front foot to the covers for a single.
Outside off, Hales shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL TIMING! Hales works it to the leg side and the fielders don't even bother chasing it as it flies to the square leg fence.
Hales has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full delivery, flicked to mid-wicket.
Wide outside off, Cook lets it through.
Outside off, pushed to the off side.
LBW appeal! Cook looks to play it forward and appears to be hit on the pads. An appeal goes up but the umpire isn't interested as it looks like the captain got an inside edge.
The ball takes the outside edge goes towards the slip region but it does not carry.
Full outside off, Cook shoulders arms to let that one through.
Short delivery outside off, tricky one, well left.
Fuller delivery outside off, the ball swings away sharply after the bounce and is an easy leave for Hales.
Length ball on middle and off, the ball swings in and hits the batsman high on the thigh pad.
Shorter ball outside off, good leave by Hales.
Length ball outside off, defended to point for a single.
FOUR! RUNS AGAIN! Full on middle and off, Captain Cook works it through square leg and the ball races across the boundary.
Length ball on middle and off, flicked to mid-wicket. This time it's an easy three for the batsmen again.

Length ball outside  off, Hales punches it through point and the ball makes its way towards the ropes. Yasir Shah sets off hot in its chase and dives for it near the boundary only to realise it has stopped. He grins sheepishly and the batsmen run a triple.
Short ball outside off, swinging widely away from Hales who leaves it alone.
Defended off the front foot by Hales presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length delivery on middle, flicked to the leg side for a single.

THAT WAS CLOSE! Length ball outside off, Cook looks to defend that one but the ball takes an inside edge and is deflected close to the stumps. There is nothing Cook can do except follow the ball with his eyes but it luckily doesn't hit the stumps.
Full ball on off, Hales drives it back to the bowler.
Good length ball outside off and swinging away, well left by Hales.
Shorter ball around off, blocked with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Fuller delivery outside off, Hales steps forward and pushes it to the covers.
Back of a length delivery around off, defended off the back foot to point.
Length ball outside off, defended to the off side.
Fuller ball outside off, 82.7 mph, angling away, Cook lets it through. Maiden over to start for Sohail Khan!
Good length delivery on the stumps, played off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller delivery outside off, defended off the front foot to the covers.
Length ball around off, defended from within the crease.
A tad short on middle and off, Cook stands tall and defends it off the back foot.
Fullish ball on middle, Cook shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
SOHAIL KHAN to bowl from the other end.
Length ball outside off, angling wide away from the batsman, left alone.
Fuller ball around off, blocked with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Hales shoulders his arms.
FOUR! Good length delivery on middle and leg, a bit of swing and Hales flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Full delivery around off, pushed to the covers. A single to get off the mark.
Length ball outside off, left alone.

The players are on the middle, with ALASTAIR COOK and ALEX HALES to begin the batting and MOHAMMAD AMIR to begin the bowling proceedings. Four slips in place Cook. Smart ploy from Pakistan. In the last Test match, the English skipper got quite a few edges which went through the gap between third slip and gully. They have closed that gap. Here we go...
TEAM CHANGES - Sami Aslam and Sohail Khan replace Shan Masood and Wahab Riaz for Pakistan while Steven Finn comes in for an injured Ben Stokes.
Toss - Misbah has won the toss and Pakistan will have a bowl first.

England on the other hand, have come back with a solid answer and managed to level the series. The pitch has a fair amount of grass on it and both teams will be banking on their fast bowlers to use it to their advantage. England will look to win their 500th home Test while Pakistan will look to bounce back and take a lead in the series. Stay tuned for the toss.

Hello and welcome to the third Test between England and Pakistan at Edgbaston. Pakistan won over hearts at Lord's with their stupendous performance in the first Test. Unfortunately, they were not able to repeat the performance at Old Trafford.
